name: valkyrie-git-lint
description: A configurable git commit linting and release report generation tool with emoji support

scripts.lint: npm run build && node dist/git-lint.js lint
scripts.report: npm run build && node dist/git-lint.js report
scripts.changelog: npm run build && node dist/git-lint.js changelog
scripts.change-log: npm run build && node dist/git-lint.js changelog
scripts.init: npm run build && node dist/git-lint.js init

author: Valkyrie Team
